questions.question: The component of the compound microscope responsible for collecting and focussing of light rays on the material is

answers.d: The use of a magnifying lens

questions.question: In light microscopy, the highest resolution is attained with

answers.a: The visible light with the longest wavelength was selected
answers.b: A lens with a small numerical aperture
answers.c: Visible light with the shortest wavelength
answers.d: The shortest visible light wavelength was chosen, as well as an objective with the highest numerical aperture
